busy: Please wait for the current operation to finish.
unreadableFiles: {count} files could not be read. First error: {error}
rawReadFailed: could not read the RAW file
importFailed: Import failed: check that the selected drive or folder is reachable and try again. {message}
telescopeUnreachable: The telescope folder is not responding: check that the telescope is on and connected to the same network, and that the path in Settings, Telescope tab, is correct.
noImagesInFolder: No images found in the selected folder: FITS, compressed FITS, XISF and RAW files are accepted.
viewReset: Image restored to how it was when opened.

abracadabra.background: sky background evened out (the difference between areas was {percent}%)
abracadabra.crop: crop of the noisy edges suggested (visible in Export)
abracadabra.noiseAndDetail: noise reduced and detail, stars and contrast adjusted
abracadabra.dualBand: dual-band file: try the HOO palette in the Process step, Narrowband card
abracadabra.done: Abracadabra complete: {items}. You can change the chosen values in the Process and Correct steps; the Reset button returns the image to the original.
abracadabra.cropNotice: Abracadabra removed the noisy edges: to see or change the crop box, press Crop in the top bar (key {key}).
